doc: Variant of Monica's dungeon action script (c02a.stb) beside c02_monica.c (c02.stb). It registers her sword hit boxes, blade trails and footstep sounds and runs the same five-hit combo, mid-range attack, charge attack, back flip, L1 magic aiming, R1 guard and throw and item use, but has no reset or stopped program and no magic charge build-up.
